note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled on Wednesday 4 June 1930 and counted at the council boardroom on the morning of 5 June (queue nominal 29 May). Munterevlin was the only contest in the district; the other divisions were returned unopposed and their names are not printed in the reports traced. Filed on 1930-06-04, the polling day for county council and rural district elections in Co. Tyrone that year (confirmed); previously filed under 1930-06-05 (verification 5 Nov 2026). The five new members returned unopposed are added from the Ulster Herald of 26 April 1930, p. 5; the re-nominated outgoing members are not named there (6 Nov 2026). Lavery (the sitting councillor) 257; Quinn 119; majority 138. Eight spoiled votes; polling was quiet, with Mr. W. J. Glasgow as presiding officer and Mr. John W. Fleming presiding at the count.
